title: Bleach
subtitle: Carrying invisible burdens
_guide_hero: Layout: Title (1-4 words), jpTitle (1-3 words), subtitle (3-6 words). Poster is right split image (2:3 portrait).

entry._guide: Layout: Centered giant text. Limit 15-40 words.
entry.breathQuote: It was the aesthetic that pulled me in. It was the quiet, unspoken weight of duty that made me stay.

reflection._guide: Layout: Right column split. Quote: 20-50 words. Tags: 2-4 items. Cards: 30-70 words.
reflection.quote: Ichigo never wanted to be a hero. He just refused to let the people in his immediate vicinity get hurt. That distinction reshaped my whole definition of responsibility.
reflection.whatIKept: You don't need a grand, world-saving philosophy to act. 'I just want to protect my friends' is a complete and sufficient moral code.
reflection.definingScene: Ichigo arriving at Sokyoku Hill. No words — just planting the sword and stopping the execution. The quiet confidence of knowing exactly what you're there to do.
reflection.whoItMadeMeThinkAbout: People who do the heavy lifting in silence, without demanding a parade for their efforts.

thoughtCascade.thought: He's always scowling, but he always helps.
He doesn't care about Soul Society's politics. He cares about Rukia.
The sword is a reflection of his internal clarity.
He fights his own inner hollow. The enemy is literally his own instinct.

_guide_thoughtCascade: Layout: Left-aligned timeline. Thought: 20-45 words. Micro: 2-5 words.

cinematicMoment._guide: Layout: Full width dark section. Body: 40-80 words. Image: 16:9 landscape.
cinematicMoment.title: Sokyoku Hill.
cinematicMoment.body: The execution is underway. The captains are assembled. Ichigo just appears and shatters the un-shatterable. It wasn't the power level — it was the gravitational pull of someone who has resolved their internal conflict.

memoryCards._guide: Layout: Hovering glass cards. Question: 5-12 words. Cards: text 30-50 words.
memoryCards.question: What stayed with me after the screen went dark?

cards.title: The Mask
cards.text: The darkness inside, made physical. You don't defeat it. You learn to control it.

cards.title: The Rain
cards.text: The inner world flooding when despair takes over. The perfect visual for a bad mental state.

cards.title: The Sword
cards.text: Zangetsu is the honest self. Your weapon is what you're willing to be when no one is directing you.

altMemories.question: What quietly changed?
altMemories.heading: I stopped looking for a grand purpose.
altMemories.body: I used to stress about my 'mission.' Ichigo made me realize your purpose can just be the people standing next to you. You don't need to save the world — just your corner of it.
altMemories.caption: Micro-duty over macro-philosophy.

_guide_altMemories: Layout: Alternating split layout. Body: 50-100 words. Image: 1:1 or 4:5.

pullQuote._guide: Layout: Giant dramatic quote. Text: 10-30 words.
pullQuote.text: If miracles only happen once, what are they called the second time?

timeline._guide: Layout: Center timeline nodes. Body: 30-60 words.

firstImpression.heading: Style and swords
firstImpression.body: I came for the character designs and the oversized weapons. It felt impossibly cool.

whatShifted.heading: The internal landscape
whatShifted.body: The real battles were inside the characters' minds. Their swords were literally their souls.

whatStayed.heading: Quiet resolve
whatStayed.body: Not screaming your ideals — just showing up and doing the work.

items.line: to focus my energy on protecting the people in my immediate radius.
when the rain starts falling inside, and address my mental state instead of fighting through it.
rules and traditions that demand suffering in the name of duty.

characters.name: Ichigo Kurosaki
characters.mirror: He challenged me to stop agonizing over the 'why' and just focus on the 'what' — protect what's in front of you.

characters.name: Byakuya Kuchiki
characters.mirror: He reflected rigid adherence to rules over empathy, and the painful process of unlearning it. I saw my own stubbornness in him.

notes.text: Your blade reflects your soul. If you're hesitating, it becomes dull.

ideas.application: Your external capability is tied to your internal clarity. You can't win outside if it's raining inside.

continueJourney.because: Because I learned to carry weight without announcing it — and to protect my corner of the world.

recommendations.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
recommendations.reason: A modern continuation of the aesthetic of duty and curses.

recommendations.title: Demon Slayer
recommendations.reason: Carrying the burden of protection with absolute empathy.
